artifact_evidence.note: Node identity: task Name/Describe identical to root, own Source fixed to the same commit entry, Version 2 (skeleton v1 filled), Dispatch.id warp_row_reduction matching the file name, and when stating the design's true access requirements (4-element state strides with 8-byte base; conv_vec clauses; mixed/output_gate divisible by 4 with 8-byte bases; out strides even) without replicating the host selector.

Math_reshape Thesis: keep the four Contract steps including the direct post-update readout, factor Q/K norms into per-token scalars applied at consumption, one full-width reduction per row, deferred RMSNorm with each readout row kept once.

Norm rewrite: invq/invk defined from the raw rows of m; neither q_hat nor k_hat is materialized — consumers form q*invq and k*invk per element, with the scale regrouping of the Contract q_hat product stated.
Recurrence header, initial state from the source slot, and pred with the decay applied per element inside the summand against k*invk — the direct (unfactored) grouping.

fma32 state update reusing the decayed state, positive-slot BF16 checkpoint, and raw as the direct sum over the UPDATED state against q*invq — no folded readout, no qdot symbol anywhere in the region.
Deferred RMSNorm: sq_part over 16-row groups with every row entering exactly once, rv = rsqrt(sum/128 + norm_eps), and the out product/cast order matching the tail source.
GDN Worktile invariants q_steps and k_steps both RAW rows — the single Work_schedule content difference from root (k_hat_steps), which is why the region is local rather than from: root.
Flow identical in content to root: two submissions, GDN start_after CONV.launch_ready, Handoff m producer CONV consumer GDN over global with wait_at GDN.mixed_ready.
GDN role ownership: warp w rows [16w,16w+16), lane l columns [4l,4l+4), thread holding 16 rows by 4 columns, every pred/raw row reduction spanning the full warp; Member warp[0:8].
norm_factors describe: every warp redundantly reduces the staged rows of each step and publishes identical values per warp, so no warp consumes another warp's result — the b2 organization.

predict/advance/readout action contracts: kn fragment and per-element decay with full-warp pred reduce and delta; fma32 advance reusing the decayed state; qn fragment with full-warp raw reduce and publication of raw(s)/sq_part(s) into raw_stage/sq_stage.
Pipe prologue order matching the source: geometry, zero_rows branch for inactive works, then state preload issued before await:conv, staging, and the first barrier.
Pipe remainder: norm_factors behind the staged barrier, second barrier (await:norms), state_init, the step loop predict/advance/readout with conditional checkpoint, await:steps and out_rows.

REALIZATION Require binding CONV.launch_ready to cudaTriggerProgrammaticLaunchCompletion at entry plus the ProgrammaticStreamSerialization attribute on the dependent launch — local, not inherited from root.

Require: 256 threads with two resident CTAs per SM (__launch_bounds__(256,2), <=128 registers), justified by this node's own budget — 64 carried FP32 + 32 preload words + 16 readout registers kept live across the full-warp reductions.
Prefer: one 8-byte vector load/store per row fragment in load:state_preload and store:checkpoint, grounded in the when alignment clauses — the object the planned vec==0 parameter record will suspend.

conclusions.subject: differences
conclusions.text: Substantive differences of this node's GDN organization against root's gdn_w11v8, each verified in the fixed source: (1) thread state ownership is 16 rows x 4 columns (warp band [16w,16w+16), lane columns [4l,4l+4)) instead of root's 4 rows x 16 columns; (2) pred and raw are each reduced per row by a full-warp 5-level __shfl_xor all-reduce over 32 four-column groups, instead of root's 3-level reduction among 8 same-column-group lanes; (3) the readout is taken directly from the updated state (the reference/Contract grouping) — there is no folded raw and no qdot scalar anywhere in the kernel; (4) smem stages RAW q and k rows in plain 128-wide layout (no 160-slot permutation, no materialized k_hat): kn/qn scaled fragments are formed per element at each consumption inside the step loop; (5) the prologue is b1 staging of q/k/v/gate plus decay/beta/dst/norm_weight, then b2 where EVERY warp redundantly recomputes invq/invk with lane-0 same-value publication, with two barriers before the step loop — versus root's one-warp-per-step norm pass that also stages q/k_hat; (6) the deferred RMSNorm keeps each raw row exactly once (sm_rawbuf[8][8][16], warp-uniform ssq stored by lane 0), so the tail divides by 128 instead of root's 8-copy /1024; (7) state preload and checkpoint use 8-byte uint2 accesses instead of root's 256-bit v8 forms; (8) at the Work_schedule level the GDN invariant set carries k_steps (raw) instead of root's k_hat_steps — the single content difference forcing the whole region local.

conclusions.subject: shared_design
conclusions.text: Content shared with root and resolved to it rather than redefined: the single CONTRACT lives only in root (this file has no CONTRACT; every ref: target — conv_weight/conv_state/mixed_qkv/mixed_qkv_updated/conv_state_updated/state/norm_weight/state_indices/result/state_updated dtypes — resolves to root's shared Contract). The CONV side is literally the same kernel and submission as root's: conv3_kernel with the entry PDL trigger before any index math, tbv[8] row prefetch burst, 4-byte history column reads and uint4 taps, exact-copy shift into columns 0/1, left-to-right FP32 accumulation with silu_fast, pack2 in-place write-back and pre-call-word append into columns 2+j, launched on grid ((channels/2+255)/256, n) under conv_vec — so this node's CONV step/pipeline objects are name-identical to root's and the existing scalar-conv, graph-replay and combination catalog records apply to them unchanged. The Flow is the same two-submission PDL structure: GDN start_after CONV.launch_ready (ProgrammaticStreamSerialization attribute) with Handoff::m waited at GDN.mixed_ready via cudaGridDependencySynchronize issued after the state preload. Shared math: sig_fast (tanh.approx.f32, source-claimed <=3.1e-4 unverified) feeding conv silu, both gate branches and beta while decay/softplus stay accurate; identical convolution accumulation and copied-history rewrite. GDN work organization is identical: one 256-thread CTA per (request, value head) on grid (value_head_count, request_count), all works submitted, len_i=0 exits at geometry, inactive requests zero len_i*head_dim out elements before any PDL wait or state access. The direct post-update readout additionally keeps the reference grouping (raw from the updated state, per-element decay inside the pred summand), so this node deviates from the Contract summation order only in the reduction tree.

conclusions.subject: walkthrough
conclusions.text: Concrete in-scope call threaded from inputs to all four outputs: tp=1 (h=16, hv=48, channels=10240, ratio=3), width=2, lengths=(3,), state_slot_padding=4 giving state.stride(0)=786436 (divisible by 4, not by 8) on the guarded 32-byte-offset base → a4 → vec==1; conv_slot_padding=32 → conv_vec; n=1 so convTotal=20 and use_fk is false because vec!=3. Host submits conv3_kernel<<<(20,1),256>>>: every block grants the PDL launch permission at entry, then each thread owns one channel pair — bursts the 3 pre-call mixed words, reads history columns off..off+2 (off=accepted-1=0) and the uint4 taps, shifts columns 0,1←1,2, convolves the 3 tokens left-to-right in FP32 with silu_fast, writes pack2 in place over mixed rows 0..2 and appends the pre-call words into columns 2..4 → mixed_qkv_updated and conv_state_updated formed. Then gdn_v1_kernel<true><<<(48,1),256,PSS>>>: block (i=0,j) reads len=3, acc=1, src=state_indices[0,0]>0 → active; issues the uint2 preload of its 16x4 state fragment from state[src,j] BEFORE cudaGridDependencySynchronize; after the sync, b1 stages q(s)=m columns g*128.., k(s)=(16+g)*128.., v(s)=(32+j)*128.., gate(s) with the sigmoid branch (the generator passes 'sigmoid'), sm_w, accurate decay, sig_fast beta and dst(s) for s=0..2; barrier; b2 has every warp compute invq/invk (32x4 sums + 5-level butterflies), lane 0 publishes; barrier; S widened to FP32 registers. Each step s: kn=k*invk, qn=q*invq; per row r: h=S*dec, pred=warp_sum(h·kn), d=(v-pred)*bet, S=fma(d,kn,h), raw=warp_sum(S·qn); dst(s)>0 → uint2 checkpoint into state[dst(s),j] → state_updated; lane 0 stores ssq, lanes<16 store the raw rows. Post-loop barrier; the tail's threads with idx2<192 write pairs out[token,j,m..m+1]=bf16(raw*rv*w*gate) with rv=rsqrt(tot/128+norm_eps) → all 3x128 result elements of this head. Edge cases: a request with src==0 or out-of-range accepted writes 3*128 zeros with no sync, no state read and no checkpoint; len=0 blocks return at geometry writing nothing; every out element has a determined producer.

conclusions.subject: when_scope
conclusions.text: Dispatch.when is written as the design's true access requirements rather than the host selector tier: the state clause (strides divisible by 4, 8-byte base) is exactly what the uint2 preload/checkpoint needs (the a4 gate); inputs with stronger state alignment also satisfy it while the host would route them to the W11/fused designs — a permitted coverage overlap, since when does not replicate the selector and the catalog keeps the routing story. The conv_vec clauses pin the conv3 side of this two-launch instance. The mixed/output_gate divisible-by-4 + 8-byte-base clauses cover the b1 uint2 staging loads, which are identical in BOTH template instances — so the planned vec==0 parameter record must keep those clauses and drop only the state-alignment clause. out.stride(0)/stride(1) even pins the paired-store tail; the odd-stride scalar fallback (same rv with /128) stays a catalog parameter via the existing out-tail record, now linkable to this node's compute:out_rows. No fusion-threshold clause is needed because use_fk requires vec==3. Within the generated input family these staging conditions hold by construction (packed stride 256*(h+hv), guarded 32-byte bases), so the scalar-conv x v1-gdn combination is interface-compatible in practice.

source_evidence.note: Kernel identity for this node: template <bool VEC> gdn_v1_kernel with __launch_bounds__(256, 2), i.e. 256-thread CTAs, at most 2 resident per SM.
Work mapping: j = blockIdx.x is the value head, i = blockIdx.y the request; warp = tid>>5, lane = tid&31; begin/len read from cu_seqlens and len <= 0 returns before any other work (empty work exit).

Activity gate acc_ok/src/active (len<=8 defensive, in-domain equivalent to gdn_active) and the inactive path: len*128 out elements zeroed then return, before the state preload and before any PDL wait.

Shared memory of this design: plain 128-wide fp32 sm_q/sm_k/sm_v/sm_g [8][128] (no 160-slot permutation, no k_hat buffer), sm_w[128], per-step scalar arrays decay/dst/beta/invq/invk, sm_ssqsq[8][8] and sm_rawbuf[8][8][16]; sm_red[8] is declared but never used (dead, not registered in the YAML).

Carried-state preload: sraw[16][2] per thread at rows m = 16*warp + r and columns 4*lane; VEC=true issues one uint2 (8-byte) load per row — the 16-rows-by-4-columns ownership and the 8-byte state access of this node.

VEC=false (vec==0) assembles the same row fragment from four 2-byte scalar loads into two unsigned words — the fact the planned P6 parameter record must capture; everything else in the kernel is identical.
PDL consumer side: cudaGridDependencySynchronize is issued after the state preload; conv-written mixed rows are read only after this sync — the await:conv action and Handoff wait_at target.
Prologue b1 staging loop: idx2 = kk*256 + tid, step s = idx2>>7 with break at s >= len (slots beyond len_i stay unwritten), part = (idx2>>5)&3 selects the operand, c4 = (idx2&31)*4 the column group.

Staging sources: parts 0/1/2 read the conv-written mixed row at qbase/kbase/vbase + c4, part 3 reads output_gate; each is one uint2 (4-element) load — these loads require the mixed/gate divisible-by-4 strides and 8-byte bases kept in this node's when for both template instances.
Gate activation branch applied at staging time: sigmoidf per element when gate_sigmoid, else x*sigmoidf (silu) — the Contract activation branch of stage_operands, using sig_fast.
Widened values are stored as float4 into sm_q[s]/sm_k[s]/sm_v[s]/sm_g[s] at column c4 — raw q and raw k rows are staged (no normalization at staging, unlike root's k_hat).
norm_weight widened to fp32 sm_w by threads tid < 128 (weight_stage).
Decay path stays accurate: dt_bias[j] widened, eA = expf(A_log[j]), softplus as log1pf(expf(x)) with the x > 20 linear branch, sm_decay[s] = expf(-eA*sp) — matches the Contract decay formula.
beta = sigmoidf(b) via the fast sigmoid; sm_dst[s] from state_indices; the first __syncthreads closes prologue b1 (await:staged).

Prologue b2 documented: every warp redundantly reduces the full 128-channel sums from smem and each lane 0 writes identical values (benign same-value stores); one barrier at the end publishes invq/invk — the 8x redundant evaluation recorded in the norm Rewrite Ledger.
b2 per step s: float4 q4/k4 read from sm_q[s]/sm_k[s] at columns 4*lane — each lane covers a 4-column group of the 128-channel row.
pq/pk are the four squares summed left to right, then warp_sum butterflies give the full 128-term reductions — the 32-groups-of-4 plus 5-level tree accumulation registered in Arithmetic.
Lane 0 publishes sm_invq[s] = rsqrtf(pq + 1e-6)*scale and sm_invk[s] = rsqrtf(pk + 1e-6); the second __syncthreads (await:norms) publishes them to all warps before the step loop.
Carried state conversion after the barriers: S[16][4] FP32 registers widened from the preloaded sraw words (compute:state_init), consuming the preload issued before the PDL wait.
Step loop head reads the per-step scalars dec/bet/ikn/iqn from smem for step s — the staged invariants consumed per iteration.

kn = kr*ikn and qn = qr*iqn: the normalized key/query fragments are formed per element once per step from the raw staged rows and the scalars — no materialized k_hat/q_hat rows (the Math Rewrite 'applied at consumption' decision).

Per row r: the decayed state h0..h3 = S[r][x]*dec is formed per element (decay inside the summand, matching the reference per-term grouping) and the pred partial starts with h0*kn.x — decay formed once and reused by the update.
pred partial accumulated left to right over the lane's 4 columns, then p = warp_sum(p): a full-warp 5-level butterfly all-reduce per row — the reduction that names this design (warp row reduction).
delta d = (sm_v[s][16*warp+r] - p)*bet from the staged value row; state advance S[r][x] = fmaf(d, kn.x, h0) — the fma32 update form reusing the decayed h; readout partial starts on the updated S.

Readout accumulated over the updated state and reduced by a second per-row full-warp butterfly into pr[r] — the direct post-update readout (Contract/reference grouping), with no folded raw and no qdot anywhere in this kernel.
Checkpoint when dst = sm_dst[s] > 0: destination base db from the dst slot and head, per-row address (16*warp + r)*sr + 4*lane; VEC selects the store form.
VEC=true checkpoint: pack2 pairs of the updated FP32 state into one uint2 (8-byte) store per row — the Prefer entry's object and the vec==1 alignment consumer.
VEC=false checkpoint: four scalar f2b stores per row — the second half of the planned vec==0 parameter record.
Deferred RMSNorm bookkeeping with no barriers inside the step loop (warps stream steps independently, source-validated W3b); ssq accumulates pr[r]^2 over the warp's 16 rows.

pr is warp-uniform after the butterfly all-reduces, so lane 0 stores sm_ssqsq[s][warp] directly (no second sum) and lanes < 16 store the 16 raw rows into sm_rawbuf[s][warp][r] — each raw row stored exactly once, hence the /128 tail.
Single post-loop __syncthreads (await:steps) before the distributed out tail.
Paired out-store branch taken when ((os0 | os1) & 1) == 0 — the out.stride(0)/stride(1) even clause of this node's when; the scalar fallback is the catalog parameter.

Out tail: idx2 = k*256 + tid over pairs, sq = idx2>>6 with break at sq >= len; tot sums the 8 warp partials of that step and rv = rsqrtf(tot * (1.0f/128.0f) + norm_eps) — the /128 divisor distinguishing this tail from root's /1024.

Paired output: m = (idx2&63)*2 selects two adjacent channels; v0/v1 = sm_rawbuf[sq][m>>4][m&15 (+1)] * rv * sm_w * sm_g left to right, pack2 into out at (begin+sq)*os0 + j*os1 + m — the compute:out_rows action and result producer.
Odd-stride scalar fallback: idx over len*128, sq = idx>>7, m = idx&127, same rv with the 1/128 divisor — the object the existing out-tail parameter record must link for this node.
warp_sum: five __shfl_xor_sync(FULLMASK) levels 16/8/4/2/1 — a full-warp all-reduce leaving every lane with the identical sum; the primitive behind all pred/raw/invq/invk reductions of this design.
sigmoidf declared as the fast sigmoid 0.5 + 0.5*tanh(x/2) via tanh.approx.f32 (1 MUFU + 2 FMA) — sig_fast in the Math region.
sigmoidf body: inline asm tanh.approx.f32 on 0.5*x, return fmaf(0.5, t, 0.5) — the exact form bound by REALIZATION Require.

Source-claimed error bound: |fast sigmoid - sigmoid| <= ~3.1e-4 (PTX 2^-10.66 halved by the 0.5 factor) against frozen tol 0.01 + 0.05*|actual|, >30x margin — recorded as Approx with the claim unverified here.
Fast sigmoid feeds conv silu, the gate activation (both sigmoid and silu ABI branches) and beta; decay/softplus stay accurate — the scope of the sig_fast rewrite.
conv3_kernel triggers cudaTriggerProgrammaticLaunchCompletion at kernel entry before computing i and the 2-channel-per-thread index — the CONV signal:launch_permission shared with root.
conv3 row prefetch burst: tbv[8] holds the len pre-call mixed words of this channel pair issued up front — the token_rows storage and load:token_rows action.
conv3 reads the three stored history columns off/off+1/off+2 as 4-byte words — the conv_operands history part of load:conv_operands.
conv3 reads the four taps of both channels as one uint4 — the conv_operands tap part (conv_weight 16-byte alignment in when).
conv3 history shift: the stored words h1u/h2u are copied verbatim into conv_state columns 0 and 1 — store:history_shift, exact BF16 copies.
conv3 accumulation: a0/a1 built left to right in FP32 from the sliding window r0/r1/r2 and token t0/t1 with taps w, then silu via sigmoidf — the conv Math step shared with root.
conv3 write-back of pack2(y0,y1) over mixed in place and append of the pre-call word tb into conv_state column 2+j — producers of mixed_qkv_updated and conv_state_updated, identical to root's CONV.
Host conv_vec gate: channels/css/csp/ms0 even, conv_state and mixed bases 4-byte aligned, conv_weight base 16-byte aligned — the conv-side clauses of this node's when.
Non-fused branch launches conv3_kernel on grid ((channels/2 + 255)/256, n) of 256-thread blocks when conv_vec — the CONV submission and Worker_count of this node, same kernel and grid as root.
GDN grid g2 = dim3(hv, n): head on blockIdx.x fastest, request on blockIdx.y — the (value_head_count, request_count) mapping and head-fastest Worktile_order.

GDN launch config: gridDim = g2, blockDim 256, single attribute cudaLaunchAttributeProgrammaticStreamSerialization allowed = 1 — the PDL consumer launch (numAttrs = 1 on the next line) shared with root's Flow.

Four-way kernel selection: vec==2 selects gdn_w11_kernel<true>, vec==1 selects gdn_v1_kernel<true> (this node's instance) and the fallback vec==0 selects gdn_v1_kernel<false> — one design text, two state-access tiers.
a4 gate: state.stride(0)/(1)/(2) all divisible by 4 and data_ptr 8-byte aligned — exactly the alignment this node's uint2 state accesses need, and the state clause of when.

vec = a16 ? 3 : (a8 ? 2 : (a4 ? 1 : 0)) — the tier selector; when deliberately states the design's a4 requirement instead of replicating this selector, so coverage overlaps the stronger tiers where the host routes elsewhere.
use_fk requires fk_flags && conv_vec && vec == 3 — the vec==1/0 tiers of this node never enter the fused path, so when needs no fusion-threshold clause.
Fusion gate fk_conv_total = ceil(channels/512)*n with the vec==3 && <= 160 condition — confirms the fused design is bound to the 16-element state tier only.

Guarded allocation helper: every generated tensor is base[16:16+n] of a larger buffer, so all data pointers carry a 16-element (32-byte) offset — the 8-byte base alignment for state/mixed/gate holds by construction.

packed row stride = qkv + hv*128 = 256*(h+hv), with mixed and gate as views of the same backing: mixed.stride(0)/output_gate.stride(0) are divisible by 4 and gs1 = 128 structurally, so the b1 uint2 staging loads are always aligned within the generated input family.

state built as_strided with stride(0) = hv*128*128 + state_slot_padding and strides (·,16384,128,1): the vec tier is selected by the padding modulo 4/8/16, e.g. padding=4 gives vec==1 (this node) and padding=1 gives vec==0.
state_slot_padding ranges 0..65536, so the vec==1 and vec==0 tiers this node covers are reachable within the declared shape range (not covered by the 10 fixed cases, which all sit in vec==3).

conv_slot_padding ranges 0..65536, so odd padding (scalar conv) is reachable; combined with the fixed mixed/gate structure the scalar-conv x v1-gdn combination stays interface-compatible within this node's when.

Reference decays the carried state per element before the pred dot (hh = carried*decay; pred = (hh*k_hat).sum) and forms delta = (v - pred)*beta — the per-term grouping this node's pred keeps (only the summation tree is regrouped).

Reference updates the state, reads raw from the UPDATED state with the materialized q_hat row, then normalizes with rsqrt(mean(raw^2)+norm_eps) — this node keeps that direct readout grouping, unlike root's folded raw.

response.summary: warp_row_reduction.yaml completed at Version 2 with all three Design regions locally defined (no from references, confirming the P4 prediction) plus local REALIZATION, faithful to the vec==1 instance gdn_v1_kernel<true>: thread ownership 16 rows x 4 columns with every pred and raw row reduced by a full-warp 5-level butterfly; direct post-update readout with no qdot and no folded raw; plain 128-wide raw q/k staging with per-warp redundant invq/invk behind two prologue barriers; deferred RMSNorm storing each raw row once with a /128 tail; uint2 (8-byte) state preload/checkpoint. CONV side and Flow are content-identical to root (same conv3_kernel, grid, entry PDL trigger, PSS dependent launch, Handoff::m at await:conv). Dispatch.when is written as the design's true access requirements. The fixed check helper could not be executed in this session (Bash denied by permission mode); Runner must run it on the saved raw.
